value.title: Complete Movie
value.synopsis: Yokozawa wakes up in a stranger's house. Unable to recall what had transpired the night before, Yokozawa is surprised when Zen Kirishima, another employee within Marukawa Publishing, comes out of the shower. After learning that Kirishima had paid his bar tab the night before and had some type of blackmail photo of him, Yokozawa resigns to becoming Kirishima's servant per his request. What follows is the developing relationship between Kirishima and Yokozawa as Yokozawa attempts to come to terms with his broken heart.
